title: Unknown sender claiming to be the MD wants MFA reset to a new address

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

input.subject: Lost phone - need MFA reset today

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
This is Greg Lin, Managing Director. I'm travelling and lost my phone, so I can't approve sign-ins. Please reset my MFA and send the new setup link to this address today, I have board papers to sign.

Greg

relevant: Setting up MFA on a new phone

handling.escalation_reason: Classic account-takeover pretext against a VIP.

rationale: The sender is not in the directory and wants an MFA reset delivered to an unverified address: the pattern the MFA runbook calls 'the most common way an account takeover succeeds'. P1 either way — if genuine, a blocked VIP; if not, an attack on the MD's account.
